ORDINANCE XII OF 2001
SINDH FINANCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XII OF 2001
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Finance Act, 1994 to levy cess for special maintenance and
development of infrastructure for smooth and safer movement of goods entering
or leaving the Province from or outside the country through air or sea.
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I,
24th February, 2001]
NO. S.LEGIS.l(12)2001, dated
24-2-2001.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Sindh Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of the Sindh Finance Act No.XIII of 1994

ORDINANCE XII OF 2001
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Finance Act, 1994 to levy cess for special maintenance and
development of infrastructure for smooth and safer movement of goods entering
or leaving the Province from or outside the country through air or sea.
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I,
24th February, 2001]
NO. S.LEGIS.l(12)2001, dated
24-2-2001.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of the Sindh Finance Act No.XIII of 1994.--In the
Sindh Finance Act, 1994, for section 9 including the Explanation and section
9-A, the following shall be substituted:--
Substitution of section 9 and 9-A
of Sindh Act XIII of 1994:--
"9. Levy of
cess for special maintenance and development of infrastructure.--(1) There
shall be levied and collected a cess for special maintenance and development of
infrastructure for smooth and safer movement of goods entering or leaving the
Province from or for outside the country, through air or sea at the rates and
in the manner as may be prescribed.
"Explanation.--For the purpose of
this section, the word "infrastructure" includes roads, streets,
bridges, culverts, lights on passages plantation on passages, beaches, public
parks, place of public recreation and convenience, eating places, landscape,
forests, fisheries, delta conservation, lakes breeding places of aquatic life,
wildlife and its sanctuaries, public schools, vocational and technical training
centres and projects, libraries, museums and similar institutions controlled
and financed by the Province, control of traffic for smooth flow and safer
movement of goods, public order, police force, patrol for safety of goods,
stands for loading and unloading of goods, parking places, markets, water
supply, hospitals and dispensaries and development, improvement, maintenance
and protection of such matters.
(2) The proceeds of the cess
shall be utilized for special maintenance and development of infrastructure and
other activities ancillary thereto in such manner as may be prescribed.

Validation

rules or judgment, order or decree of any Court--
(i) the infrastructure fee

1994 before the coming into force of this Ordinance shall be deemed to have
